headline: Best week of the season; Gibraltar still needs the climbing
body:
This week is your best of the season by a wide margin — 44 miles against a previous high of 27. That is the first real block of training you have strung together, and it arrives with 50 days left.

The distance is closable. Your longest ride so far is 16.3 miles and the 100 km asks for 62, but seven more weeks like this one, with the long ride stretched each weekend, gets you there.

Gibraltar is the harder answer. The most you have climbed in a single ride is 475 feet; the ascent alone is 2,551 feet at 8 percent, and your entire season adds up to 3,744 feet — less than the +Climb route asks of you in one morning. On the evidence, you are training for the Coastal route.

Friday and Saturday reach 90°. Keep those early and short, and take the long ride Sunday or Monday in the high 70s.
